name: Antonov An-2 Colt
summary: Huge Soviet single-bay utility biplane with a 1,000 hp radial. Mass-produced for passenger, cargo and ag work; a few operate in the US.

wings: Large single-bay biplane; the upper wing is noticeably longer than the lower
Automatic leading-edge slats on the upper wing
engines: Single nine-cylinder radial (about 1,000 hp) in a big round cowl
fuselage: Large, deep fuselage with a roomy cabin and rectangular windows
Tall fixed main gear with a tailwheel

tellTales: Giant single-bay biplane with a short lower wing
Huge radial and four-blade prop up front
Tall fixed gear under a deep, boxy fuselage

confusedWith.howToTell: The Stearman is a small open-cockpit trainer biplane; the An-2 is far bigger with a deep enclosed cabin and a longer upper wing.
The Ag-Cat is a small single-seat biplane duster; the An-2 is a giant airframe with a large passenger cabin.
The Staggerwing has a lower wing farther forward than the upper and a sleek cabin; the An-2 is a big boxy biplane with a long upper wing.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
